df = pd.read_csv("E:/Submitted Manuscripts/2026/Plos Water/fd.csv")

###############################################################
# DEFINE TARGET
###############################################################

target = "SWD"

###############################################################
# DATA LEAKAGE ASSESSMENT
###############################################################

print("\n")
print("="*60)
print("DATA LEAKAGE ASSESSMENT")
print("="*60)

# Variables occurring AFTER disease onset

potential_leakage = [
    "MA",       # Seek Medical Assistance
    "TT",       # Treatment Type
    "MAWD"      # Most Affected Household Member
]

print("\nPotential Leakage Variables")

for var in potential_leakage:

    if var in df.columns:
        print(var)

print("\nRecommendation")

print("""
These variables occur AFTER disease occurrence and may
contain information unavailable during prediction.

Recommended:

Remove:
MA
TT
MAWD

when building the deployment prediction model.
""")

###############################################################
# HIGHLY CORRELATED VARIABLES
###############################################################

print("\n")
print("="*60)
print("Highly Correlated Variables")
print("="*60)

corr_matrix=corr.abs()

upper=corr_matrix.where(
    np.triu(
        np.ones(corr_matrix.shape),
        k=1
    ).astype(bool)
)

threshold=0.80

high_corr=[]

for column in upper.columns:

    for row in upper.index:

        if upper.loc[row,column]>threshold:

            high_corr.append(
                [
                    row,
                    column,
                    upper.loc[row,column]
                ]
            )

high_corr=pd.DataFrame(
    high_corr,
    columns=[
        "Variable1",
        "Variable2",
        "Correlation"
    ]
)

print(high_corr)

high_corr.to_excel(
    "Highly_Correlated_Features.xlsx",
    index=False
)

###############################################################
# VIF
###############################################################

print("\n")
print("="*60)
print("Variance Inflation Factor")
print("="*60)

X=data.drop(columns=[target])

vif=pd.DataFrame()

vif["Variable"]=X.columns

vif["VIF"]=[
    variance_inflation_factor(
        X.values,
        i
    )
    for i in range(X.shape[1])
]

vif=vif.sort_values(
    by="VIF",
    ascending=False
)

print(vif)

vif.to_excel(
    "VIF_Table.xlsx",
    index=False
)

)

    "Variable":X.columns,

    by="Mutual_Information",

###############################################################
# PART 2B-1
# BORUTA FEATURE SELECTION
# Publication-quality Script

###############################################################

# pip install boruta

###############################################################
# IMPORT LIBRARIES
###############################################################

import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier

from boruta import BorutaPy

###############################################################
# RANDOM SEED
###############################################################

RANDOM_STATE = 42

np.random.seed(RANDOM_STATE)

###############################################################
# LOAD DATA
###############################################################

df = pd.read_excel("E:/Submitted Manuscripts/2026/Plos WaterLeakage_Free_Dataset.xlsx")

###############################################################
# DEFINE TARGET
###############################################################

TARGET = "SWD"

###############################################################
# CHECK DATA
###############################################################

print("="*60)
print("Dataset Shape")
print(df.shape)

print("="*60)
print(df.head())

###############################################################
# ENCODE CATEGORICAL VARIABLES
###############################################################

label_encoder = LabelEncoder()

for col in df.columns:

    if df[col].dtype == "object":

        df[col] = label_encoder.fit_transform(
            df[col].astype(str)
        )

###############################################################
# SPLIT FEATURES
###############################################################

X = df.drop(columns=[TARGET])

y = df[TARGET]

feature_names = X.columns

###############################################################
# CHECK CLASS DISTRIBUTION
###############################################################

print("\nTarget Distribution")

print(y.value_counts())

###############################################################
# RANDOM FOREST FOR BORUTA
###############################################################

rf = RandomForestClassifier(

    n_estimators=1000,

    max_depth=None,

    class_weight="balanced",

    random_state=RANDOM_STATE,

    n_jobs=-1

)

import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.feature_selection import RFECV

###############################################################
# RANDOM SEED
###############################################################

RANDOM_STATE = 42
np.random.seed(RANDOM_STATE)

###############################################################
# LOAD DATA
###############################################################

df = pd.read_excel("E:/Submitted Manuscripts/2026/Plos Water/Leakage_Free_Dataset.xlsx")

###############################################################
# TARGET VARIABLE
###############################################################

TARGET = "SWD"

###############################################################
# STEP 1
# TRAIN TEST SPLIT
###############################################################

import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold

RANDOM_STATE = 42

###############################################################
# LOAD DATA
###############################################################

df = pd.read_excel("E:/Submitted Manuscripts/2026/Plos Water/RFECV.xlsx")

###############################################################
# TARGET
###############################################################

TARGET = "SWD"

###############################################################
# FEATURES
###############################################################

X = df.drop(columns=[TARGET])

y = df[TARGET]

###############################################################
# TRAIN TEST SPLIT
###############################################################

X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(

    X,
    y,

    test_size=0.20,

    stratify=y,

    random_state=RANDOM_STATE

)

print(X_train.shape)
print(X_test.shape)

###############################################################
# CV
###############################################################

cv = StratifiedKFold(

    n_splits=5,

    shuffle=True,

    random_state=RANDOM_STATE

)

(400, 10)
(101, 10)

#Step 2 (Logistic Regression)
###############################################################
# LOGISTIC REGRESSION
###############################################################

from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression

from sklearn.model_selection import RandomizedSearchCV

###############################################################
# PIPELINE
###############################################################

pipe_lr = Pipeline([

    ("scaler", StandardScaler()),

    ("model", LogisticRegression(
        class_weight="balanced",
        random_state=42,
        max_iter=5000
    ))

])

###############################################################
# SEARCH SPACE
###############################################################

param_lr = {

    "model__penalty":["l1","l2"],

    "model__C":np.logspace(-4,4,100),

    "model__solver":["liblinear"]

}

###############################################################
# RANDOM SEARCH
###############################################################

lr_search = RandomizedSearchCV(

    estimator=pipe_lr,

    param_distributions=param_lr,

    n_iter=50,

    scoring="roc_auc",

    cv=cv,

    random_state=42,

    n_jobs=-1,

    verbose=2

)

###############################################################
# FIT
###############################################################

lr_search.fit(

    X_train,

    y_train

)

###############################################################
# RESULTS
###############################################################

print(lr_search.best_params_)

print(lr_search.best_score_)

best_lr = lr_search.best_estimator_

#Step 2.1: Evaluate the tuned Logistic Regression model
###############################################################
# TEST PERFORMANCE
###############################################################

from sklearn.metrics import (
    accuracy_score,
    precision_score,
    recall_score,
    f1_score,
    roc_auc_score,
    confusion_matrix
)

# Predictions
y_pred = best_lr.predict(X_test)

# Predicted probabilities
y_prob = best_lr.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]

# Metrics
accuracy = accuracy_score(y_test, y_pred)
precision = precision_score(y_test, y_pred)
recall = recall_score(y_test, y_pred)
specificity = confusion_matrix(y_test, y_pred)[0,0] / (
    confusion_matrix(y_test, y_pred)[0,0] +
    confusion_matrix(y_test, y_pred)[0,1]
)
f1 = f1_score(y_test, y_pred)
auc = roc_auc_score(y_test, y_prob)

print("="*60)
print("Logistic Regression Performance")
print("="*60)

print(f"Accuracy    : {accuracy:.3f}")
print(f"Precision   : {precision:.3f}")
print(f"Recall      : {recall:.3f}")
print(f"Specificity : {specificity:.3f}")
print(f"F1-score    : {f1:.3f}")
print(f"AUC         : {auc:.3f}")

print("\nConfusion Matrix")
print(confusion_matrix(y_test, y_pred))

from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.model_selection import RandomizedSearchCV

rf = RandomForestClassifier(
    random_state=42,
    class_weight="balanced"
)

param_rf = {
    "n_estimators": [200, 300, 500, 700, 1000],
    "max_depth": [None, 5, 10, 15, 20, 30],
    "min_samples_split": [2, 5, 10, 15],
    "min_samples_leaf": [1, 2, 4, 6],
    "max_features": ["sqrt", "log2", None],
    "bootstrap": [True, False]
}

rf_search = RandomizedSearchCV(
    estimator=rf,
    param_distributions=param_rf,
    n_iter=50,
    scoring="roc_auc",
    cv=cv,
    random_state=42,
    n_jobs=-1,
    verbose=2
)

rf_search.fit(X_train, y_train)

print("Best Parameters:")
print(rf_search.best_params_)

print("\nBest CV AUC:")

#SVM tuning
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.svm import SVC
from sklearn.model_selection import RandomizedSearchCV
import numpy as np

pipe_svm = Pipeline([
    ("scaler", StandardScaler()),
    ("model", SVC(probability=True, random_state=42))
])

param_svm = {
    "model__C": np.logspace(-3, 3, 100),
    "model__gamma": ["scale", "auto"] + list(np.logspace(-4, 1, 20)),
    "model__kernel": ["rbf", "linear", "poly"]
}

svm_search = RandomizedSearchCV(
    estimator=pipe_svm,
    param_distributions=param_svm,
    n_iter=50,
    scoring="roc_auc",
    cv=cv,
    random_state=42,
    n_jobs=-1,
    verbose=2
)

svm_search.fit(X_train, y_train)

print("Best Parameters:")
print(svm_search.best_params_)

print("Best CV AUC:")
print(svm_search.best_score_)

best_svm = svm_search.best_estimator_

#ROC curve compare
###############################################################
# COMBINED ROC CURVES FOR ALL MODELS
###############################################################

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

from sklearn.metrics import (
    roc_curve,
    roc_auc_score
)

###############################################################
# PREDICTED PROBABILITIES
###############################################################

# Logistic Regression
lr_prob = best_lr.predict_proba(X_test)[:,1]

# Random Forest
rf_prob = best_rf.predict_proba(X_test)[:,1]

# SVM
svm_prob = best_svm.predict_proba(X_test)[:,1]

# KNN
knn_prob = best_knn.predict_proba(X_test)[:,1]

# XGBoost
xgb_prob = best_xgb.predict_proba(X_test)[:,1]

###############################################################
# ROC CURVES
###############################################################

lr_fpr, lr_tpr, _ = roc_curve(y_test, lr_prob)
rf_fpr, rf_tpr, _ = roc_curve(y_test, rf_prob)
svm_fpr, svm_tpr, _ = roc_curve(y_test, svm_prob)
knn_fpr, knn_tpr, _ = roc_curve(y_test, knn_prob)
xgb_fpr, xgb_tpr, _ = roc_curve(y_test, xgb_prob)

###############################################################
# AUC VALUES
###############################################################

lr_auc = roc_auc_score(y_test, lr_prob)
rf_auc = roc_auc_score(y_test, rf_prob)
svm_auc = roc_auc_score(y_test, svm_prob)
knn_auc = roc_auc_score(y_test, knn_prob)
xgb_auc = roc_auc_score(y_test, xgb_prob)

###############################################################
# PLOT
###############################################################

plt.figure(figsize=(8,7))

plt.plot(
    lr_fpr,
    lr_tpr,
    linewidth=2,
    label=f'Logistic Regression (AUC={lr_auc:.3f})'
)

plt.plot(
    rf_fpr,

#Decision Curve Analysis (All Five Models)
###############################################################
# DECISION CURVE ANALYSIS (ALL MODELS)
###############################################################

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

###############################################################
# PREDICTED PROBABILITIES
###############################################################

lr_prob = best_lr.predict_proba(X_test)[:,1]
rf_prob = best_rf.predict_proba(X_test)[:,1]
svm_prob = best_svm.predict_proba(X_test)[:,1]
knn_prob = best_knn.predict_proba(X_test)[:,1]
xgb_prob = best_xgb.predict_proba(X_test)[:,1]

###############################################################
# FUNCTION
###############################################################

def decision_curve(y_true, y_prob, thresholds):

    net_benefit = []

    N = len(y_true)

    for pt in thresholds:

        pred = (y_prob >= pt).astype(int)

        TP = np.sum((pred==1)&(y_true==1))
        FP = np.sum((pred==1)&(y_true==0))

        NB = (TP/N) - (FP/N)*(pt/(1-pt))

        net_benefit.append(NB)

    return np.array(net_benefit)

###############################################################
# THRESHOLDS
###############################################################

thresholds = np.linspace(0.01,0.99,99)

###############################################################
# MODEL NET BENEFIT
###############################################################

nb_lr = decision_curve(y_test.values, lr_prob, thresholds)

nb_rf = decision_curve(y_test.values, rf_prob, thresholds)

nb_svm = decision_curve(y_test.values, svm_prob, thresholds)

nb_knn = decision_curve(y_test.values, knn_prob, thresholds)

nb_xgb = decision_curve(y_test.values, xgb_prob, thresholds)

###############################################################
# TREAT ALL
###############################################################

prevalence = np.mean(y_test)

treat_all = prevalence - (1-prevalence)*(thresholds/(1-thresholds))

###############################################################
# TREAT NONE
###############################################################

treat_none = np.zeros_like(thresholds)

###############################################################
# PLOT
###############################################################

plt.figure(figsize=(8,7))

plt.plot(thresholds,nb_lr,label='Logistic Regression',linewidth=2)

plt.plot(thresholds,nb_rf,label='Random Forest',linewidth=2)

plt.plot(thresholds,nb_svm,label='SVM',linewidth=2)

plt.plot(thresholds,nb_knn,label='KNN',linewidth=2)

plt.plot(thresholds,nb_xgb,label='XGBoost',linewidth=2)

plt.plot(
    thresholds,
    treat_all,
    linestyle='--',
    color='black',
    label='Treat All'
)

plt.plot(
    thresholds,
    treat_none,
    linestyle=':',
    color='black',
    label='Treat None'
)

###############################################################
# FORMAT
###############################################################

plt.xlabel("Threshold Probability",fontsize=12)

plt.ylabel("Net Benefit",fontsize=12)

plt.title("Decision Curve Analysis",fontsize=14)

plt.legend()

plt.grid(alpha=0.3)

###############################################################
# SAVE
###############################################################

plt.tight_layout()

plt.savefig(
    "Decision_Curve_Analysis.png",
    dpi=600,
    bbox_inches="tight"
)

plt.show()

#Step 1: Bootstrap AUC for Random Forest
###############################################################
# BOOTSTRAP 95% CONFIDENCE INTERVAL FOR ROC-AUC
###############################################################

import numpy as np
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score

###############################################################
# FUNCTION
###############################################################

def bootstrap_auc(y_true,
                  y_prob,
                  n_bootstraps=2000,
                  random_state=42):

    rng = np.random.RandomState(random_state)

    bootstrapped_scores = []

    for i in range(n_bootstraps):

        indices = rng.randint(
            0,
            len(y_true),
            len(y_true)
        )

        # Need both classes
        if len(np.unique(y_true.iloc[indices])) < 2:
            continue

        score = roc_auc_score(
            y_true.iloc[indices],
            y_prob[indices]
        )

        bootstrapped_scores.append(score)

    bootstrapped_scores = np.array(bootstrapped_scores)

    lower = np.percentile(
        bootstrapped_scores,
        2.5
    )

    upper = np.percentile(
        bootstrapped_scores,
        97.5
    )

    mean_auc = roc_auc_score(
        y_true,
        y_prob
    )

    return mean_auc, lower, upper

    ("Logistic Regression", best_lr.predict_proba(X_test)[:,1]),

    ("SVM", best_svm.predict_proba(X_test)[:,1]),

]:

    auc, lower, upper = bootstrap_auc(
        y_test,
        prob
    )

    results.append([
        name,
        round(auc,3),
        round(lower,3),
        round(upper,3)
    ])

import pandas as pd

auc_table = pd.DataFrame(

    results,

    columns=[
        "Model",
        "AUC",
        "95% CI Lower",
        "95% CI Upper"
    ]

)

print(auc_table)

auc_table.to_csv(
    "Bootstrap_AUC_CI.csv",

)

###############################################################
# 95% CONFIDENCE INTERVALS USING BOOTSTRAPPING
###############################################################

import numpy as np
from sklearn.utils import resample
from sklearn.metrics import (
    accuracy_score, precision_score, recall_score,
    f1_score, roc_auc_score
)

n_bootstrap = 1000
rng = np.random.RandomState(42)

metrics_bootstrap = {
    "Accuracy": [],
    "Precision": [],
    "Recall": [],
    "Specificity": [],
    "F1-score": [],
    "ROC-AUC": []
}

# Bootstrap resampling
for i in range(n_bootstrap):

    # resample test indices
    indices = rng.choice(
        np.arange(len(y_test)),
        size=len(y_test),
        replace=True
    )

    y_true_boot = np.array(y_test)[indices]
    y_pred_boot = np.array(y_pred_stack)[indices]
    y_prob_boot = np.array(y_prob_stack)[indices]

    # confusion matrix
    cm_boot = confusion_matrix(
        y_true_boot,
        y_pred_boot
    )

    # avoid division errors
    if cm_boot.shape == (2,2):

        specificity_boot = (
            cm_boot[0,0] /
            (cm_boot[0,0] + cm_boot[0,1])
        )

        metrics_bootstrap["Specificity"].append(
            specificity_boot
        )

    metrics_bootstrap["Accuracy"].append(
        accuracy_score(y_true_boot, y_pred_boot)
    )

    metrics_bootstrap["Precision"].append(
        precision_score(
            y_true_boot,
            y_pred_boot,
            zero_division=0
        )
    )

    metrics_bootstrap["Recall"].append(
        recall_score(
            y_true_boot,
            y_pred_boot,
            zero_division=0
        )
    )

    metrics_bootstrap["F1-score"].append(
        f1_score(
            y_true_boot,
            y_pred_boot,
            zero_division=0
        )
    )

    # AUC requires both classes
    if len(np.unique(y_true_boot)) == 2:
        metrics_bootstrap["ROC-AUC"].append(
            roc_auc_score(
                y_true_boot,
                y_prob_boot
            )
        )


###############################################################
# PRINT 95% CI
###############################################################

print("="*60)
print("STACKING ENSEMBLE 95% CONFIDENCE INTERVALS")
print("="*60)

for metric, values in metrics_bootstrap.items():

    values = np.array(values)

    lower = np.percentile(values, 2.5)
    upper = np.percentile(values, 97.5)

    print(
        f"{metric:12s}: "
        f"{np.mean(values):.3f} "
        f"(95% CI: {lower:.3f}–{upper:.3f})"
    )

============================================================
STACKING ENSEMBLE 95% CONFIDENCE INTERVALS
============================================================
Accuracy    : 0.594 (95% CI: 0.495–0.703)
Precision   : 0.638 (95% CI: 0.536–0.744)
Recall      : 0.829 (95% CI: 0.725–0.916)
Specificity : 0.188 (95% CI: 0.062–0.324)

)

plt.plot([0,1],[0,1],"k--")

plt.xlabel("False Positive Rate")

plt.ylabel("True Positive Rate")

plt.title("ROC Curve - Weighted Soft Voting")

plt.legend(loc="lower right")

plt.grid(alpha=0.3)

plt.tight_layout()

plt.savefig(
    "Weighted_Voting_ROC.png",
    dpi=600,
    bbox_inches="tight"
)

plt.show()

#Step 3: Cross-validation
###############################################################
# CROSS VALIDATION
###############################################################

cv = StratifiedKFold(
    n_splits=5,
    shuffle=True,
    random_state=42
)

results = []

for weights in weight_sets:

    model = VotingClassifier(

        estimators=[

            ("rf", best_rf),

            ("lr", best_lr),

            ("xgb", best_xgb)

        ],

        voting="soft",

        weights=weights,

        n_jobs=-1

    )

    scores = cross_val_score(

        model,

        X_train,

        y_train,

        scoring="roc_auc",

        cv=cv,

        n_jobs=-1

    )

    results.append({

        "Weights": str(weights),

        "Mean AUC": scores.mean(),

        "Std": scores.std()

    })

# ============================================================
# Publication-quality RFECV Performance Curve
# Logistic Regression & Random Forest
# ============================================================

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from sklearn.feature_selection import RFECV
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Assume:
# X_train = training predictor dataframe
# y_train = training outcome
# feature_names = X_train.columns
# ------------------------------------------------------------

cv = StratifiedKFold(
    n_splits=5,
    shuffle=True,
    random_state=42
)

# ============================================================
# Logistic Regression RFECV
# ============================================================

lr = LogisticRegression(
    max_iter=1000,
    random_state=42
)

rfecv_lr = RFECV(
    estimator=lr,
    step=1,
    cv=cv,
    scoring='roc_auc',
    n_jobs=-1
)

rfecv_lr.fit(X_train, y_train)

# ============================================================
# Random Forest RFECV
# ============================================================

rf = RandomForestClassifier(
    n_estimators=500,
    random_state=42,
    n_jobs=-1
)

rfecv_rf = RFECV(
    estimator=rf,
    step=1,
    cv=cv,
    scoring='roc_auc',
    n_jobs=-1
)

rfecv_rf.fit(X_train, y_train)

# ============================================================
# Plot
# ============================================================

plt.rcParams.update({
    "font.size":12,
    "axes.labelsize":13,
    "axes.titlesize":14
})

fig, ax = plt.subplots(
    1,
    2,
    figsize=(12,5),
    dpi=300
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Logistic Regression
# ------------------------------------------------------------

scores_lr = rfecv_lr.cv_results_["mean_test_score"]
features_lr = np.arange(1, len(scores_lr)+1)

ax[0].plot(
    features_lr,
    scores_lr,
    marker='o',
    linewidth=2
)

ax[0].axvline(
    rfecv_lr.n_features_,
    linestyle='--'
)

ax[0].scatter(
    rfecv_lr.n_features_,
    max(scores_lr),
    s=80,
    zorder=5
)

ax[0].set_xlabel("Number of Selected Features")
ax[0].set_ylabel("Mean Cross-validated ROC-AUC")
ax[0].set_title("(A) Logistic Regression")
ax[0].grid(alpha=0.3)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Random Forest
# ------------------------------------------------------------

scores_rf = rfecv_rf.cv_results_["mean_test_score"]
features_rf = np.arange(1, len(scores_rf)+1)

ax[1].plot(
    features_rf,
    scores_rf,
    marker='o',
    linewidth=2
)

ax[1].axvline(
    rfecv_rf.n_features_,
    linestyle='--'
)

ax[1].scatter(
    rfecv_rf.n_features_,
    max(scores_rf),
    s=80,
    zorder=5
)

ax[1].set_xlabel("Number of Selected Features")
ax[1].set_ylabel("Mean Cross-validated ROC-AUC")
ax[1].set_title("(B) Random Forest")
ax[1].grid(alpha=0.3)

plt.tight_layout()

# ============================================================
# Save Figure
# ============================================================

plt.savefig(
    "Figure_3_RFECV_Performance.png",
    dpi=600,
    bbox_inches="tight"
)

plt.savefig(
    "Figure_3_RFECV_Performance.tiff",
    dpi=600,
    bbox_inches="tight"
)

plt.show()

# ============================================================
# Selected Variables
# ============================================================

print("\n==============================")
print("Logistic Regression RFECV")
print("==============================")
print("Optimal number of features:",
      rfecv_lr.n_features_)

selected_lr = X_train.columns[rfecv_lr.support_]
print(selected_lr.tolist())

print("\n==============================")
print("Random Forest RFECV")
print("==============================")
print("Optimal number of features:",
      rfecv_rf.n_features_)

selected_rf = X_train.columns[rfecv_rf.support_]
print(selected_rf.tolist())

# ============================================================
# Generate Supplementary Tables S1 and S2
# ============================================================

import pandas as pd

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Replace these object names if necessary
# ------------------------------------------------------------

models = {
    "Logistic Regression": random_search_lr,
    "Random Forest": random_search_rf,
    "Support Vector Machine": random_search_svm,
    "K-Nearest Neighbors": random_search_knn,
    "XGBoost": random_search_xgb
}

# ============================================================
# Supplementary Table S1
# Hyperparameter Search Space
# ============================================================

table_s1 = []

for model_name, model in models.items():

    param_space = model.param_distributions

    for param, values in param_space.items():

        # convert search space to readable text
        if isinstance(values, (list, tuple)):
            value_text = ", ".join(map(str, values))
        else:
            value_text = str(values)

        table_s1.append({

            "Algorithm": model_name,
            "Hyperparameter": param,
            "Search Space": value_text

        })

table_s1 = pd.DataFrame(table_s1)

print("\nSupplementary Table S1")
display(table_s1)

# ============================================================
# Supplementary Table S2
# Best Hyperparameters
# ============================================================

table_s2 = []

for model_name, model in models.items():

    idx = model.best_index_

    table_s2.append({

        "Algorithm": model_name,

        "Optimal Hyperparameters":
        "; ".join([f"{k}={v}" for k,v in model.best_params_.items()]),

        "Mean CV ROC-AUC":
        round(model.cv_results_["mean_test_score"][idx],4),

        "SD":
        round(model.cv_results_["std_test_score"][idx],4)

    })

table_s2 = pd.DataFrame(table_s2)

print("\nSupplementary Table S2")
display(table_s2)

# ============================================================
# Export
# ============================================================

with pd.ExcelWriter(
    "Supplementary_Tables_S1_S2.xlsx"
) as writer:

    table_s1.to_excel(
        writer,
        sheet_name="Table S1",
        index=False
    )

    table_s2.to_excel(
        writer,
        sheet_name="Table S2",
        index=False
    )

print("\nDone!")
print("File saved as: Supplementary_Tables_S1_S2.xlsx")

# ==========================================================
# Hyperparameter Optimization using RandomizedSearchCV
# ==========================================================

import numpy as np

from sklearn.model_selection import RandomizedSearchCV, StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.svm import SVC
from sklearn.neighbors import KNeighborsClassifier

from xgboost import XGBClassifier

RANDOM_STATE = 42

cv = StratifiedKFold(
    n_splits=5,
    shuffle=True,
    random_state=RANDOM_STATE
)

# ==========================================================
# Logistic Regression
# ==========================================================

pipe_lr = Pipeline([
    ("scaler", StandardScaler()),
    ("model", LogisticRegression(
        max_iter=1000,
        random_state=RANDOM_STATE
    ))
])

param_lr = {
    "model__penalty": ["l1","l2"],
    "model__C": np.logspace(-3,2,20),
    "model__solver": ["liblinear"]
}

lr_search = RandomizedSearchCV(
    estimator=pipe_lr,
    param_distributions=param_lr,
    n_iter=20,
    scoring="roc_auc",
    cv=cv,
    random_state=RANDOM_STATE,
    n_jobs=-1,
    verbose=2
)

lr_search.fit(X_train,y_train)

print("Logistic Regression Completed")
print(lr_search.best_params_)
print("ROC-AUC:",lr_search.best_score_)

# ==========================================================
# Random Forest
# ==========================================================

rf = RandomForestClassifier(
    random_state=RANDOM_STATE
)

param_rf = {

    "n_estimators":[100,200,300,500],

    "max_depth":[None,5,10,20,30],

    "min_samples_split":[2,5,10],

    "min_samples_leaf":[1,2,4],

    "max_features":["sqrt","log2"],

    "bootstrap":[True,False]

}

rf_search = RandomizedSearchCV(

    estimator=rf,

    param_distributions=param_rf,

    n_iter=30,

    scoring="roc_auc",

    cv=cv,

    random_state=RANDOM_STATE,

    n_jobs=-1,

    verbose=2

)

rf_search.fit(X_train,y_train)

print("\nRandom Forest Completed")
print(rf_search.best_params_)
print("ROC-AUC:",rf_search.best_score_)

# ==========================================================
# Support Vector Machine
# ==========================================================

pipe_svm = Pipeline([

    ("scaler",StandardScaler()),

    ("model",SVC(probability=True,
                 random_state=RANDOM_STATE))

])

param_svm={

    "model__kernel":["linear","rbf"],

    "model__C":np.logspace(-2,2,20),

    "model__gamma":["scale","auto"]

}

svm_search=RandomizedSearchCV(

    estimator=pipe_svm,

    param_distributions=param_svm,

    n_iter=20,

    scoring="roc_auc",

    cv=cv,

    random_state=RANDOM_STATE,

    n_jobs=-1,

    verbose=2

)

svm_search.fit(X_train,y_train)

print("\nSVM Completed")
print(svm_search.best_params_)
print("ROC-AUC:",svm_search.best_score_)

# ==========================================================
# K-Nearest Neighbors
# ==========================================================

pipe_knn=Pipeline([

    ("scaler",StandardScaler()),

    ("model",KNeighborsClassifier())

])

param_knn={

    "model__n_neighbors":[3,5,7,9,11,13,15],

    "model__weights":["uniform","distance"],

    "model__metric":["euclidean","manhattan"]

}

knn_search=RandomizedSearchCV(

    estimator=pipe_knn,

    param_distributions=param_knn,

    n_iter=20,

    scoring="roc_auc",

    cv=cv,

    random_state=RANDOM_STATE,

    n_jobs=-1,

    verbose=2

)

knn_search.fit(X_train,y_train)

print("\nKNN Completed")
print(knn_search.best_params_)
print("ROC-AUC:",knn_search.best_score_)

# ==========================================================
# XGBoost
# ==========================================================

xgb=XGBClassifier(

    objective="binary:logistic",

    eval_metric="logloss",

    random_state=RANDOM_STATE,

    use_label_encoder=False

)

param_xgb={

    "n_estimators":[100,200,300],

    "max_depth":[3,5,7],

    "learning_rate":[0.01,0.05,0.1,0.2],

    "subsample":[0.6,0.8,1.0],

    "colsample_bytree":[0.6,0.8,1.0],

    "min_child_weight":[1,3,5],

    "gamma":[0,0.1,0.3]

}

xgb_search=RandomizedSearchCV(

    estimator=xgb,

    param_distributions=param_xgb,

    n_iter=30,

    scoring="roc_auc",

    cv=cv,

    random_state=RANDOM_STATE,

    n_jobs=-1,

    verbose=2

)

xgb_search.fit(X_train,y_train)

print("\nXGBoost Completed")
print(xgb_search.best_params_)
print("ROC-AUC:",xgb_search.best_score_)

# ==========================================================
# Best Models
# ==========================================================

best_lr = lr_search.best_estimator_
best_rf = rf_search.best_estimator_
best_svm = svm_search.best_estimator_
best_knn = knn_search.best_estimator_
best_xgb = xgb_search.best_estimator_

print("\nAll hyperparameter optimization completed successfully.")

    idx=model.best_index_

    rows.append({

        "Algorithm":model_name,

        "Optimal Hyperparameters":
        "; ".join([f"{k}={v}" for k,v in model.best_params_.items()]),

        "Mean CV ROC-AUC":

)

###############################################################
# STEP 7
# TRAIN OPTIMIZED MODELS
###############################################################

from sklearn.metrics import (
    accuracy_score,
    precision_score,
    recall_score,
    f1_score,
    roc_auc_score,
    confusion_matrix
)

###############################################################
# BEST MODELS
###############################################################

best_lr  = lr_search.best_estimator_
best_rf  = rf_search.best_estimator_
best_svm = svm_search.best_estimator_
best_knn = knn_search.best_estimator_
best_xgb = xgb_search.best_estimator_

###############################################################
# STORE MODELS
###############################################################

models = {

    "Logistic Regression": best_lr,

    "Random Forest": best_rf,

    "Support Vector Machine": best_svm,

    "K-Nearest Neighbors": best_knn,

    "XGBoost": best_xgb

}

###############################################################
# MODEL EVALUATION
###############################################################

results = []

for name, model in models.items():

    # -------------------------
    # Prediction
    # -------------------------

    y_pred = model.predict(X_test)

    y_prob = model.predict_proba(X_test)[:,1]

    # -------------------------
    # Confusion Matrix
    # -------------------------

    tn, fp, fn, tp = confusion_matrix(
        y_test,
        y_pred
    ).ravel()

    specificity = tn / (tn + fp)

    # -------------------------
    # Metrics
    # -------------------------

    results.append({

        "Model": name,

        "Accuracy": accuracy_score(y_test,y_pred),

        "Precision": precision_score(y_test,y_pred),

        "Recall": recall_score(y_test,y_pred),

        "Specificity": specificity,

        "F1-score": f1_score(y_test,y_pred),

        "ROC-AUC": roc_auc_score(y_test,y_prob)

    })

###############################################################
# RESULTS TABLE
###############################################################

results_df = pd.DataFrame(results)

results_df = results_df.round(3)

results_df = results_df.sort_values(
    "ROC-AUC",
    ascending=False
)

print(results_df)

###############################################################
# SAVE
###############################################################

results_df.to_excel(

    "Model_Performance.xlsx",

    index=False

)

print("\nModel performance exported successfully.")

###############################################################
# STEP 2
# LOGISTIC REGRESSION

from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.model_selection import RandomizedSearchCV
import numpy as np

pipe_lr = Pipeline([

    ("scaler", StandardScaler()),

    ("model", LogisticRegression(
        random_state=42,
        max_iter=1000
    ))

])

param_lr = {

    "model__C": np.logspace(-3,2,100),

    "model__penalty": ["l1","l2"],

    "model__solver": ["liblinear"]

}

lr_search = RandomizedSearchCV(

    pipe_lr,

    param_distributions=param_lr,

    n_iter=20,

    scoring="roc_auc",

    cv=cv,

    random_state=42,

    n_jobs=-1,

    verbose=2

)

lr_search.fit(X_train, y_train)

print("\nLogistic Regression Completed")

print(lr_search.best_params_)

print("ROC-AUC:", lr_search.best_score_)

###############################################################
# STEP 7
# TRAIN OPTIMIZED MODELS AND EVALUATE ON TEST SET
###############################################################

import pandas as pd
from sklearn.metrics import (
    accuracy_score,
    precision_score,
    recall_score,
    f1_score,
    roc_auc_score,
    confusion_matrix
)

###############################################################
# BEST ESTIMATORS
###############################################################

best_lr = lr_search.best_estimator_
best_rf = rf_search.best_estimator_
best_svm = svm_search.best_estimator_
best_knn = knn_search.best_estimator_
best_xgb = xgb_search.best_estimator_

###############################################################
# STORE MODELS
###############################################################

models = {
    "Logistic Regression": best_lr,
    "Random Forest": best_rf,
    "Support Vector Machine": best_svm,
    "K-Nearest Neighbors": best_knn,
    "XGBoost": best_xgb
}

###############################################################
# MODEL EVALUATION
###############################################################

results = []

predictions = {}

for name, model in models.items():

    # Fit optimized model on training data
    model.fit(X_train, y_train)

    # Predictions
    y_pred = model.predict(X_test)

    # Predicted probabilities
    y_prob = model.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]

    predictions[name] = {
        "pred": y_pred,
        "prob": y_prob
    }

    # Confusion matrix
    tn, fp, fn, tp = confusion_matrix(y_test, y_pred).ravel()

    specificity = tn / (tn + fp)

    results.append({
        "Model": name,
        "Accuracy": accuracy_score(y_test, y_pred),
        "Precision": precision_score(y_test, y_pred),
        "Recall": recall_score(y_test, y_pred),
        "Specificity": specificity,
        "F1-score": f1_score(y_test, y_pred),
        "ROC-AUC": roc_auc_score(y_test, y_prob)
    })

###############################################################
# PERFORMANCE TABLE
###############################################################

results_df = pd.DataFrame(results)

results_df = results_df.round(3)

results_df = results_df.sort_values(
    by="ROC-AUC",
    ascending=False
)

print(results_df)

###############################################################
# EXPORT TABLE
###############################################################

results_df.to_excel(
    "Table_Model_Performance.xlsx",
    index=False
)

print("\nModel performance table saved successfully.")

# STEP 8
# COMPARATIVE ROC CURVES
###############################################################

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

from sklearn.metrics import roc_curve
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score

###############################################################
# CREATE FIGURE
###############################################################

plt.figure(figsize=(8,7))

###############################################################
# COLORS
###############################################################

colors = {

    "Logistic Regression":"blue",

    "Random Forest":"red",

    "Support Vector Machine":"green",

    "K-Nearest Neighbors":"orange",

    "XGBoost":"purple"

}

###############################################################
# PLOT ROC CURVES
###############################################################

for name in predictions.keys():

    y_prob = predictions[name]["prob"]

    fpr, tpr, _ = roc_curve(y_test, y_prob)

    auc = roc_auc_score(y_test, y_prob)

    plt.plot(

        fpr,

        tpr,

        lw=2,

        color=colors[name],

        label=f"{name} (AUC = {auc:.3f})"

    )

###############################################################
# DIAGONAL
###############################################################

plt.plot(

    [0,1],

    [0,1],

    linestyle="--",

    color="black"

)

###############################################################
# LABELS
###############################################################

plt.xlabel("False Positive Rate", fontsize=12)

plt.ylabel("True Positive Rate (Sensitivity)", fontsize=12)

plt.title("Comparative ROC Curves of Machine Learning Models", fontsize=14)

plt.legend(

    loc="lower right",

    fontsize=10

)

plt.grid(alpha=0.3)

###############################################################
# SAVE FIGURE
###############################################################

plt.savefig(

    "Figure_ROC_Curves.png",

    dpi=300,

    bbox_inches="tight"

)

plt.show()

###############################################################
# STEP 9
# CALIBRATION CURVES
###############################################################

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

from sklearn.calibration import calibration_curve
from sklearn.metrics import brier_score_loss

###############################################################
# FIGURE
###############################################################

plt.figure(figsize=(8,7))

###############################################################
# COLORS
###############################################################

colors = {

    "Logistic Regression":"blue",

    "Random Forest":"red",

    "Support Vector Machine":"green",

    "K-Nearest Neighbors":"orange",

    "XGBoost":"purple"

}

###############################################################
# STORE BRIER SCORES
###############################################################

calibration_results = []

###############################################################
# PLOT CALIBRATION CURVES
###############################################################

for name in predictions.keys():

    y_prob = predictions[name]["prob"]

    fraction_of_positives, mean_predicted_value = calibration_curve(

        y_test,

        y_prob,

        n_bins=10,

        strategy="uniform"

    )

    brier = brier_score_loss(y_test, y_prob)

    calibration_results.append({

        "Model":name,

        "Brier Score":round(brier,4)

    })

    plt.plot(

        mean_predicted_value,

        fraction_of_positives,

        marker="o",

        linewidth=2,

        color=colors[name],

        label=f"{name} (Brier={brier:.3f})"

    )

###############################################################
# PERFECT CALIBRATION
###############################################################

plt.plot(

    [0,1],

    [0,1],

    linestyle="--",

    color="black",

    label="Perfect Calibration"

)

###############################################################
# LABELS
###############################################################

plt.xlabel("Mean Predicted Probability", fontsize=12)

plt.ylabel("Observed Proportion", fontsize=12)

plt.title("Calibration Curves of Machine Learning Models", fontsize=14)

plt.legend(loc="upper left")

plt.grid(alpha=0.3)

###############################################################
# SAVE
###############################################################

plt.savefig(

    "Figure_Calibration_Curves.png",

    dpi=300,

    bbox_inches="tight"

)

plt.show()

###############################################################
# BRIER SCORE TABLE
###############################################################

calibration_results = pd.DataFrame(calibration_results)

print(calibration_results)

calibration_results.to_excel(

    "Calibration_Brier_Scores.xlsx",

    index=False

)

print("\nCalibration results exported.")

In [114]:
###############################################################
# DCA FUNCTION
###############################################################

def decision_curve(y_true, y_prob, thresholds):

    N = len(y_true)

    net_benefit = []

    for pt in thresholds:

        pred = (y_prob >= pt).astype(int)

        TP = np.sum((pred == 1) & (y_true == 1))
        FP = np.sum((pred == 1) & (y_true == 0))

        nb = (TP/N) - (FP/N) * (pt/(1-pt))

        net_benefit.append(nb)

    return np.array(net_benefit)

In [128]:
###############################################################
# BOOTSTRAP FUNCTION
###############################################################

def bootstrap_auc(y_true, y_prob, n_bootstraps=2000):

    rng = np.random.RandomState(42)

    scores = []

    y_true = np.array(y_true)

    y_prob = np.array(y_prob)

    for i in range(n_bootstraps):

        indices = rng.randint(0, len(y_true), len(y_true))

        if len(np.unique(y_true[indices])) < 2:
            continue

        score = roc_auc_score(

            y_true[indices],

            y_prob[indices]

        )

        scores.append(score)

    scores = np.array(scores)

    lower = np.percentile(scores, 2.5)

    upper = np.percentile(scores, 97.5)

    return (

        roc_auc_score(y_true, y_prob),

        lower,

        upper

    )

###############################################################
# EVALUATION FUNCTION
###############################################################

def evaluate_model(name, model):

    y_pred = model.predict(X_test)

    y_prob = model.predict_proba(X_test)[:,1]

    tn,fp,fn,tp = confusion_matrix(

        y_test,

        y_pred

    ).ravel()

    specificity = tn/(tn+fp)

    return {

        "Model":name,

        "Accuracy":accuracy_score(y_test,y_pred),

        "Precision":precision_score(y_test,y_pred),

        "Recall":recall_score(y_test,y_pred),

        "Specificity":specificity,

        "F1-score":f1_score(y_test,y_pred),

        "ROC-AUC":roc_auc_score(y_test,y_prob)

    }

###############################################################
# RUN
###############################################################

ensemble_results=[]

ensemble_results.append(

    evaluate_model(

        "Weighted Soft Voting",

        soft_voting

    )

)

ensemble_results.append(

    evaluate_model(

        "Stacking Ensemble",

        stack_model

    )

)

ensemble_results=pd.DataFrame(

    ensemble_results

)

ensemble_results=ensemble_results.round(3)

#5. Confusion Matrix Heatmap
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

plt.figure(figsize=(5,4))
sns.heatmap(
    cm,
    annot=True,
    fmt='d',
    cmap='Blues',
    xticklabels=['Predicted 0', 'Predicted 1'],
    yticklabels=['Actual 0', 'Actual 1']
)

plt.xlabel("Predicted Class")
plt.ylabel("Actual Class")
plt.title("Random Forest Confusion Matrix")
plt.show()

prob_true, prob_pred = calibration_curve(
    y_test,
    y_prob_rf,
    n_bins=10
)

plt.figure(figsize=(6,5))
plt.plot(prob_pred, prob_true, marker='o')
plt.plot([0,1],[0,1],'--')
plt.xlabel("Mean Predicted Probability")
plt.ylabel("Observed Probability")
plt.title("Calibration Curve")
plt.show()

#7. Out-of-Bag (OOB) Error
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier

best_rf = RandomForestClassifier(
    n_estimators=500,
    max_depth=3,
    max_features='log2',
    min_samples_leaf=4,
    random_state=42,
    n_jobs=-1,
    oob_score=True
)

best_rf.fit(X_train, y_train)

print("OOB Score:", best_rf.oob_score_)
print("OOB Error:", 1 - best_rf.oob_score_)

#8. Permutation Feature Importance (More Reliable)
from sklearn.inspection import permutation_importance

perm = permutation_importance(
    best_rf,
    X_test,
    y_test,
    n_repeats=20,
    random_state=42
)

perm_df = pd.DataFrame({
    'Feature': X_test.columns,
    'Importance': perm.importances_mean
}).sort_values('Importance', ascending=False)

#10. Learning Curve (Optional)
from sklearn.model_selection import learning_curve
import numpy as np

train_sizes, train_scores, test_scores = learning_curve(
    best_rf,
    X_train,
    y_train,
    cv=5,
    scoring='accuracy'
)

plt.figure(figsize=(6,5))
plt.plot(train_sizes,
         np.mean(train_scores, axis=1),
         label='Training')

plt.plot(train_sizes,
         np.mean(test_scores, axis=1),
         label='Validation')

plt.xlabel("Training Samples")
plt.ylabel("Accuracy")
plt.legend()
plt.title("Learning Curve")
plt.show()
